entities.summary: Alexander Roediger was a Russo-German General of Infantry who fought in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–78, served as a member of the Imperial Russian State Council, and was the Minister of War of the Russian Empire (1905–1909). He also briefly served as the Minister of War of the Principality of Bulgaria (1883).
